en-us.erav_debt_paid_kanon_intro: Your phone buzzes. A message from $kanon.name$.
en-us.erav_debt_paid_kanon_first:
"This month's interest came in."
"Honestly, I didn't expect you to pull it together on the first try. ...Looks like I wasn't wrong about you. Keep it up."
en-us.erav_debt_paid_kanon_resumed:
"Interest received."
"You know what last month cost. You paid this time — don't let it lapse again. I'd like to see the same figure next month."
en-us.erav_debt_paid_kanon_routine: "This month's interest is in. Same again next month."
en-us.erav_debt_paid_kanon_milestone1:
"One more thing. Counting this one, what you've handed the Kiryu-gumi is past three million."
"People in the family are starting to remember the Miyama name. That's a good thing."
en-us.erav_debt_paid_kanon_milestone2:
"As of today, what you've paid the Kiryu-gumi is past five million."
"The family respects people who deliver on time. Some matters can be talked about openly from here on."
en-us.erav_debt_paid_kanon_milestone3:
"Past ten million in total."
"At this point you're not just someone in debt — you're a business partner of the Kiryu-gumi. If you need something, come see me at the office."
